scaling.$description: value that scales sizing/padding/margin linearly, i.e.: scaling-03 * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of sizing/padding/margin, i.e.: scaling-03 + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales breakpoint tokens in category dimension linearly, i.e.: breakpoint.lg * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of breakpoint tokens in category dimension, i.e.: breakpoint.lg + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales reference leading/line-height, i.e.: leading.02 * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of leading/line-height, i.e.: leading.02 + offset
value that is added on top of font-weight, i.e.: font-weight-light + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales font-weight linearly, i.e.: font-weight-light * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of font-size, i.e.: text-base + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales font-size linearly, i.e.: text-base * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of letter-spacing, i.e.: tracking-wider + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales letter-spacing linearly, i.e.: tracking-tight * scaling
value that scales border-radius linearly, i.e.: radius.sm * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of border-radius, i.e.: radius.sm + offset
value that is added on top of blur tokens in category dimension, i.e.: blur.sm + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales blur tokens in category dimension linearly, i.e.: blur.sm * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of opacity, i.e.: opacity-10 + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales opacity linearly, i.e.: opacity-10 * scaling

offset.$description: value that is added on top of container tokens in category dimension, i.e.: container.5xl + offset

scaling.$description: value that scales container tokens in category dimension linearly, i.e.: container.5xl * scaling

xs.$description: Extra small font size. The third smallest font size.

md.$description: Medium font size. Usually the next size larger from the default font size.

3xl.$description: 3X Large font size. The largest font size.

3xs.$description: 3X Small font size. The smallest font size.

2xl.$description: 2X Large font size. The second largest font size.

base.$description: The default font size from which all other font sizes are scaled.

xl.$description: Extra large font size. The third largest font size.

sm.$description: Small font size. Usually the default font size.

2xs.$description: 2X Small font size. The second smallest font size.

emphasis.$description: Variation on the default text style used when text requires spoken emphasis. Used for <em>.

quote.$description: Variation on the default text style used when quoting text from another location. Used for <blockquote>.

level-3.$description: Heading style used for the next most important headings after heading level two. Can be used multiple times on each page or screen. Used for <h3>.

level-2.$description: Heading style used for the next most important headings after heading level one. Can be used multiple times on each page or sctreen. Used for <h2>.

level-1.$description: Heading style used for the most important title or page title. Only use once on each page or screen. Used for <h1>.

scale.$description: The number used to multiply the base font size to get the typographic scale / hierarchy. The higher the number, the more dramatic difference between font sizes.

regular-italic.$description: Regular (not bold) weight, italic text style.

regular-roman.$description: Regular (not bold) weight, roman (not italic) text style.

bold-roman.$description: Bold weight, roman (not italic) text style.

title.$description: Display title style used for dramatic text sizes on landing pages. Can be used for <h1> or <h2>.
